rows.note: This is the all-purpose compact noun for a person who expects a favourable outcome.

example.english: He is an optimist and always thinks things will turn out well.
example.traditional: 佢係個樂觀派，成日覺得件事最後會有好結果。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 lok6 gun1 paai3 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 gin6 si6 zeoi3 hau6 wui5 jau5 hou2 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this neutral descriptive phrase when you want to say simply that someone is an optimistic person.

example.english: My younger sister is an optimist and believes she will find a job soon even if she becomes unemployed.
example.traditional: 我妹係個樂觀嘅人，就算失業都相信好快搵到工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui6 hai6 go3 lok6 gun1 ge3 jan4 zau6 syun3 sat1 jip6 dou1 soeng1 seon3 hou2 faai3 wan2 dou3 gung1
